prelaunch_checks: Root independent review and explicit freeze of this plan and protocol before execution
Recompute every source_bindings hash and refuse drift
Output directory, hardware record and process log must all be absent; no overwrite or automatic retry
Confirm process timeout1800,CPU0 and worker command exactly as frozen; redirect stdout/stderr to exclusive-create process log
No overlapping timed sampler or compilation work; public acquisition only

completion.followup: Independent acquisition/provenance audit and anchor/feature audit required before any fitting

failures.124: Contained1800second timeout; preserve partial files, no completion claim, no automatic retry
failures.2: Collector incomplete: metadata/discovery/sequence/budget/network failure or insufficient activity-qualified universe; preserve evidence
failures.missing_summary: Incomplete even if another artifact exists; never infer successful acquisition
failures.source_mismatch: Abort before network; if detected midrun retain incomplete summary
failures.missing_or_nonzero_job_cleanup: Containment failure; do not run additional work until process cleanup verified

retrospective_selection: Rank first-day eligible trades only; metadata checks expiry>historical panel end and creation<=historical start. No current is_active filter. Current retrieval may occur after contract expiry; historic names discovered from trades, never reconstructed from a surviving current instrument universe.

history_v3_compatibility.discovery: same complete inclusive recursion and saturated-tie failclosed logic
history_v3_compatibility.history: same independent timestamp boundary probes/tie pages then sequence-only overlap and contiguous-sequence validation
history_v3_compatibility.metadata: same public/get_instrument by discovered historical name; invalid/unavailable metadata fails closed

interpretation: Activity selection is prospective relative to uninspected held-out historical outcomes, not live precommitted trading. No guarantee of dense future targets.
review: Root reviewed fixed unseen historical window, activity requirements, history-v3 compatibility, complete discovery, no-relaxation policy, exact contained command and failure rules before any requests.
